title: DICGC Risk-based Premium Framework for Deposit Insurance in India
summary: DICGC with RBI approval advised banks on Risk-Based Premium framework under Section 15(1) of DICGC Act 1961. Flat rate 12 paise/₹100 replaced by Tier 1/2 CAMELS models with up to 33.33% risk incentive and 25% vintage incentive from April 1, 2026.
examAngle: 🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on exact statutory limits, financial outlays, and regulatory frameworks.
